title: Słuchanie – 6 krótkich nagrań (syntezator mowy)
intro: Posłuchaj każdego nagrania dwa razy i wybierz odpowiedź.

items.explanation: Chce większy rozmiar, nie zwrot pieniędzy.
items.script:
A: Hi, I'd like to return this jumper. It's too small.
B: Do you have the receipt?
A: Yes, here it is. I'd like a bigger size, not a refund.

items.prompt: How long does the tour last?
items.explanation: The tour lasts about an hour.
items.script: Welcome to the city museum. The guided tour starts at half past ten and lasts about an hour. Tickets for students cost five pounds. You can leave your bags in the cloakroom for free.

items.prompt: Why can't the boy go to the concert?
items.script:
A: Are you going to the concert on Friday?
B: I wanted to, but my cousin is visiting us, so I can't.
A: What a pity! I'll send you a recording.

items.prompt: When does the train leave now?
items.script:
A: The train to Gdańsk is delayed by twenty minutes.
B: So it leaves at ten past five, not ten to five?
A: No, it was supposed to leave at ten to five, now it leaves at ten past five.

items.explanation: Dzwoni w sprawie wynajmu ogłoszonego mieszkania.
items.script: Hi, it's Maria. I'm calling about the flat you advertised. I'd like to see it on Saturday morning if possible. Please call me back on 555 0123. Thanks!

items.prompt: Why will the girl take the bus?
options: The weather is bad and her bike is broken
items.explanation: Częsty deszcz i rower do naprawy.
items.script:
A: I think I'll take the bus to school from now on.
B: Why? You always cycled.
A: It's raining so often these days, and my bike needs repairing.
